Title: Azure Database for PostgreSQL single server is now available in Switzerland regions

Body.Content:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL is now generally available in the recently announced regions of Switzerland. With the addition of Azure Database for PostgreSQL to these regions, you can now use this cloud-based opportunity to accelerate innovation, support people across the continent who are working to transform their businesses, explore new entrepreneurship opportunities, and help solve some of the world’s hardest problems.

For up-to-date information about the regional availability of Azure Database for PostgreSQL, see products available by region.
